description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of two language models, Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale, across three categories of answer quality: Correct, Partially Correct, and Incorrect. The horizontal axis displays the model names, listed as Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale, while the vertical axis represents the value, labeled without units, and ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by a stacked bar composed of three colored segments. The “Correct” responses are represented by a dark blue segment, “Partially Correct” by a medium blue segment, and “Incorrect” by a light blue segment. For Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the “Correct” segment reaches a value of approximately 92.9, the “Partially Correct” segment reaches 4.3, and the “Incorrect” segment is a small segment at approximately 2.7. For RedWhale, the “Correct” segment reaches a value of approximately 95.7, the “Partially Correct” segment reaches 1.4, and the “Incorrect” segment reaches 2.9. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized. A legend at the bottom of the chart clarifies the color coding for each answer quality category.
